title: Excavation Combination Bucket
descrption: 4 in 1 combination bucket with jaw actuation and electro-magnetic pick up capabilities. The jaw is fabricated with welded steel and the rest of the attachment is aluminium.

title: Drivetrain
descrption: 200W Brushless motors with a 40 to 1 planetary reduction. This drive system allows Perseus to traverse all kinds of terrain with ease thanks to the power of the motors and our controll systems.

title: Wheels
descrption: Large 3D printed PETG wheels with tough annd flexible TPU tires.

title: Suspension
descrption: 4-wheel rocker suspension which allows for extreme wheel travel. After competing with Artemis and it's 6 wheel system we switched to 4 wheels to accelerate manufacturing and development with almost no loss off performance.

title: Compute
descrption: Jetson Orin Nano running ROS2 for sensor integation and rover control. Custom ESP32 boards run embedded code to interface with hardware. A Raspberry pi 5 is used for the camera and image processing.
